title: Geometry of Straight Lines: Parallel Lines and Transversals
seo_title: Grade 8 Geometry of Straight Lines Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and describe pairs of angles formed by perpendicular lines, intersecting lines and parallel lines cut by a transversal; solve geometric problems using the relationships between pairs of angles described above.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 8 geometry worksheets: angles on a line, vertically opposite angles, corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Z: alternate. F: corresponding. C: co-interior = 180°.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Angles on a line add to 180°; around a point to 360°; vertically opposite angles are equal.
  • When a transversal cuts parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal (F shape).
  • Alternate angles are equal (Z shape).
  • Co-interior angles add up to 180° (C shape).

Examples

Example

Co-interior angles 3x and 2x + 30°

5x + 30 = 180

Answer: x = 30°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Alternate or corresponding?Z is alternate; F is corresponding.
Co-interior are equalThey add up to 180°.
360° on a lineA straight line is 180°.

faq.a: Show that corresponding or alternate angles are equal.
